description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
When the Saprolings enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping Blasting Station. 
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from steps 5 and 10, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
When Scourge of Nel Toth enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat from step 5.
